description: LCXOS — the shell capabilities the operator desk needs. The `lcxos-desk` set (permissions/lcxos-desk.toml) is the app's OWN native commands, which before build.rs declared an ACL manifest were reachable with no permission consulted at all; `deny-is-terminal` is an absolute denial of the one registered command nothing invokes. `local: true` with no `remote` block is stated rather than inherited: no remote origin gets any of this.
